message: External OpenAI safety-check block incident, Reviewer / Wayfold, 2026-11-06. Verbatim error: "Script error: This tool call was blocked by OpenAI's safety checks. Please double check what you are sending." No Jarvis LedgerFailure or authorization error was returned. Intended action: persist review findings for Task286 and claim Task302. Recommend acceptance of the bounded intermediate change."}); claim_review({"projectName":"Wayfold","agentId":"Reviewer","taskId":"302","requestId":"3eb5528d5c7a46a3b2f0533f602105aa","expectedRequestVersion":1}). Reviewer had previously claimed Task286 successfully, read-only tools worked. No successful findings persistence or Task302 claim in the blocked calls.
